message:
System Update — Autumn v2 · May 2026
Several new features are now live across the platform. A weather tool has been integrated, enabling Autumn to pull real-time conditions directly into conversation. A formal GitHub login system is now active — signing in with your GitHub account unlocks personal memory storage that persists across sessions in a private repository only you can access.
A developer branch has been established so future updates can be staged and tested before reaching the live environment. On occasion you may notice updates applied during active sessions — we appreciate your patience as we continue to refine the experience.
You can now submit feedback directly through your profile menu in the main header. We welcome your thoughts as we continue to build.
Coming soon: a more robust standalone natural language processing engine for Autumn. In the meantime, adding an Anthropic API key in your account settings is recommended to significantly enhance response quality and language processing capability.
— Radical Deepscale LLC
author: dartsolarpunk
